story:
God opens the sea so His people can cross safely, and Miriam leads everyone in a joyful thank-you dance! A Bible story for kids with Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli and Pip, plus a sing-along song at the end. (Exodus 14-15)

Memory verse: "Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth." Psalm 100:1
Memory line: Thank You, God, I shout for joy!

Talk about it together:
- Ages 2-3: What did Miriam play? (A tambourine!)
- Ages 4-8: How did God take care of His people at the sea? How did they say thank you? How can we say thank you to God today?

Prayer: Dear God, thank You for taking care of us. Thank You for our food and our family. We shout for joy! Amen.

Activity: Make a tambourine from a paper plate and dried beans, then dance and say three things you are thankful for.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Walls of water, tall and wide
God made a path to the other side
Everybody walked through dry
Under the big blue sky

[Chorus]
Shout for joy, shout for joy
Every girl and every boy
Clap your hands and sing out loud
Thank You, God, I'm shouting loud!

[Verse 2]
Miriam picked up her tambourine
Shake, shake, shake, the happiest scene
Dancing, twirling, hands up high
Thank You, God, we're free and dry!

[Chorus]
Shout for joy, shout for joy
Every girl and every boy
Clap your hands and sing out loud
Thank You, God, I'm shouting loud!

[Verse 3]
Little ones and grown-ups too
Clapping, dancing, me and you
God is good and God is near
Thank You, God, we're glad You're here!

[Chorus - lifted]
Shout for joy, shout for joy
Every girl and every boy
Clap your hands and sing out loud
Thank You, God, I'm shouting loud!

[Outro]
Shout for joy!
Shout for joy!
